supply_observations.initial: Trade-enabled GE purchase is modeled as two ropes, shortbow, twenty bronze arrows, spade, tinderbox and twenty-five lobsters, consuming a provisional 60,000 coins.
supply_observations.in_dungeon: The plank, bucket and spare tinderbox are found along the dungeon route, with named producers. Quest badges, shadow, ashes, blood and dove are obtained in their own stages.
supply_observations.failure: Planned-success gates record agility traps, paladins/demons, Kalrag and Iban. Failure should lead to recovery/restocking before the next stage. One fall-recovery action is optional rather than mandatory.
